summary: Verified Video Room (Ruang Video Call) backend + frontend. Backend (pytest, 4/4 passed in 44s): POST /api/conversations/{cid}/summary returns 400 on empty conversation; returns non-empty summary + creates Workspace task type='meeting_notes', status='completed', goal starting 'Notulen rapat:' (verified via GET /api/tasks diff). POST /api/conversations/{cid}/send with moderator=false on a meeting type does NOT emit any is_moderator SSE event; with moderator=true (default) a moderator start+delta+final block is emitted. Frontend (desktop 1440x900, demo@aivora.ai meeting cid dba6c41f...): header 'Video Call' button (video-call-btn) visible on type!=private, click opens video-room overlay; tiles rendered for vr-tile-me, vr-tile-<persona> (Rio and one unnamed persona), vr-tile-mod; controls vr-mute/vr-send/vr-captions/vr-end-save/vr-leave all visible. Captions toggle correctly keeps vr-caption count = 0 when no caption exists (expected: {showCaption && caption}). End+save triggers POST /api/conversations/{cid}/summary, Workspace page shows multiple 'Notulen rapat: Meeting: , Rio' tasks (new one from this run visible with 20 kredit). Dark theme is intentional. No visual overlap seen in grid layout.

ui_bugs.issue: After POST /summary succeeds and the task is persisted, the overlay stays visible for a long time while awaiting TTS playback. In headless/no-autoplay environments the `await new Promise(...a.play().catch(resolve))` can take noticeably long before the overlay closes (observed >90s wait). The notulen is already saved, so UX could feel laggy. Consider a timeout wrapper (e.g., Promise.race with 8s) or close overlay immediately after summary success and play TTS in the background.

If a conversation member has empty name, data-testid becomes 'vr-tile-' (empty suffix); testid still unique in current conv but is a data-quality gap. Underlying cause: one persona for demo user has name=''. Also label at bottom of tile is empty.

action_items: (Optional) Wrap endMeeting TTS playback in a short timeout (e.g., 8s) or close overlay right after /summary success so the overlay doesn't appear to hang. Toast is also fired after the TTS wait completes.
(Optional) Backfill or guard against empty persona names in meeting members (vr-tile-<name> testid + visible label).
critical_code_review_comments: chat.py meeting_summary: summary task uses credits text_credits(history, summary) — correct. However the endpoint doesn't check conv.type == 'meeting'; if called on a 'group' or 'private' conversation with history it will still succeed and create a 'Notulen rapat:' task. Minor correctness nit; the frontend only exposes this via Video Room (group+meeting), but tightening the server-side check would be safer.
VideoRoom.endMeeting: TTS playback is awaited before closing overlay. Prefer close-first-then-play or Promise.race with timeout to avoid long perceived delay.
VideoRoom.Tile data-testid uses raw persona.name; could clash if two personas share the same name. Prefer vr-tile-<persona.id> internally and still render display name as text.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (video-call-btn, overlay, all tiles, all 5 controls, captions toggle logic, end+save -> Notulen rapat task on /workspace)

Hands-free voice/mic flow cannot be tested in headless browser (no microphone/no autoplay). End+save flow may take 60-120s in headless due to TTS await; the task save itself happens immediately after /summary returns.
rca of the issue: No functional bugs. Minor UX latency on endMeeting due to awaiting TTS playback in a Promise that resolves only on onended/onerror/play().catch; headless browser denies autoplay so .catch(resolve) fires but can take several seconds, delaying overlay close. Fix: Promise.race(ttsPromise, timeout(6-8s)) or close overlay first and continue TTS in background.
